## Teaching & Learning Resources {#teaching-learning-resources}

Explore ideas for engaging lectures and tools for visual mathematical learning. Open either resource below; each can be expanded independently.

{{< include _attention.qmd >}}

```{=html}
<details class="attention-disclosure function-disclosure" id="interactive-function-studio">
<summary><span class="attention-disclosure-copy"><span class="attention-disclosure-title">Visual Mathematics Lab</span><span class="attention-disclosure-description">Write equations, search by description, and explore interactive graphs.</span></span><span class="attention-disclosure-action" aria-hidden="true"></span></summary>
<div class="function-disclosure-body">
<p>Turn mathematical ideas into visual intuition. Enter an equation directly, or search a curated library by behavior and compare matching functions before adding one to the main graph.</p>
<section class="function-studio" id="function-studio" aria-labelledby="function-studio-title">
  <div class="function-studio-intro">
    <div>
      <span class="function-studio-kicker">VISUAL MATHEMATICS LAB</span>
      <h3 id="function-studio-title">Sketch an equation. Search by behavior. See the function.</h3>
      <p>The studio and function search run entirely in your browser. Separate equations with semicolons to compare several curves.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="function-studio-legend" aria-label="Supported notation">
      <span>sin · cos · tan</span><span>exp · log · sqrt</span><span>abs · π · e</span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="function-studio-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Function input method">
    <button id="function-tab-equation" class="active" type="button" role="tab" aria-selected="true" aria-controls="function-panel-equation" data-function-tab="equation"><span>01</span> Write equations</button>
    <button id="function-tab-description" type="button" role="tab" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="function-panel-description" data-function-tab="description"><span>02</span> Search by description</button>
  </div>

  <div class="function-studio-workspace">
    <div class="function-studio-controls">
      <div id="function-panel-equation" class="function-tab-panel active" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="function-tab-equation" data-function-panel="equation">
        <label for="function-equation"><strong>Equation</strong><small>Use x as the variable; y = is optional.</small></label>
        <textarea id="function-equation" rows="4" spellcheck="false">sin(x); 0.12x^2 - 2</textarea>
        <button class="function-secondary-button" id="function-copy-equations" type="button">Copy equations</button>
        <p class="function-status" id="function-copy-equations-status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
        <div class="function-example-row" aria-label="Equation examples">
          <button type="button" data-function-example="sin(x)">Wave</button>
          <button type="button" data-function-example="exp(-0.5x^2)">Bell curve</button>
          <button type="button" data-function-example="1 / (1 + exp(-x))">Logistic</button>
          <button type="button" data-function-example="sin(3x) * exp(-0.25abs(x))">Damped</button>
        </div>
        <div class="function-domain-row">
          <label for="function-x-min"><span>x minimum</span><input id="function-x-min" type="number" value="-10" step="1"></label>
          <label for="function-x-max"><span>x maximum</span><input id="function-x-max" type="number" value="10" step="1"></label>
        </div>
        <button class="function-primary-button" id="function-draw" type="button">Draw function <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></button>
        <p class="function-status" id="function-status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
      </div>

      <div id="function-panel-description" class="function-tab-panel" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="function-tab-description" data-function-panel="description" hidden>
        <label for="function-description"><strong>Search the function library</strong><small>Use shape, behavior, direction, or familiar mathematical terms.</small></label>
        <textarea id="function-description" rows="5" placeholder="Try: a downward parabola, growth that levels off, or a fading wave with frequency 3..."></textarea>
        <div class="function-prompt-row" aria-label="Description examples">
          <button type="button" data-function-prompt="A periodic wave with faster oscillations">Fast wave</button>
          <button type="button" data-function-prompt="An S-shaped curve that levels off">S-curve</button>
          <button type="button" data-function-prompt="A symmetric bell-shaped peak centered at zero">Bell peak</button>
        </div>
        <button class="function-primary-button" id="function-suggest" type="button">Search functions <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></button>
        <p class="function-description-note" id="function-suggestion-status" role="status" aria-live="polite">Free local search—no AI service, account, or API charge. Results update as you type.</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="function-graph-panel">
      <div class="function-graph-head"><div><span>LIVE PREVIEW</span><strong id="function-graph-title">Comparing 2 functions</strong></div><div class="function-graph-actions"><button id="function-copy-graph" type="button">Copy graph</button><button id="function-save-graph" type="button" hidden>Save PNG</button><button id="function-reset" type="button">Reset view</button></div></div>
      <p class="function-status" id="function-copy-graph-status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
      <div class="function-canvas-wrap"><canvas id="function-canvas" width="900" height="560" aria-label="Cartesian graph of the entered mathematical functions"></canvas><div class="function-coordinate" id="function-coordinate" aria-hidden="true"></div></div>
      <div class="function-curve-key" id="function-curve-key" aria-label="Graph legend"></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="function-suggestions" id="function-suggestions" aria-live="polite" hidden>
    <div class="function-suggestions-head"><div><span>LIBRARY RESULTS</span><h3>Functions matching your search</h3></div><p>Select a preview to move it into the equation workspace.</p></div>
    <div class="function-suggestion-grid" id="function-suggestion-grid"></div>
  </div>
</section>
</div>
</details>
<script src="../assets/js/function-studio.js"></script>
```

## Questions and support

For course-specific office hours and assistance, visit the relevant course page. For general questions about these teaching resources, use the [Let's Connect](../contact-me/) page and include the title of the resource in your message.

Save this page for future reference. New course pages, tutorials, assignments, schedules, and other teaching materials will be posted here as they become available.
